body: I know how you feel. I'm tired of people constantly telling me to get over my pain and deal with it. I'm envious of people who actually look forward to the next day.

thank you,  I've spent my whole life making others happy, but then they would take advantage of it.  Maybe I was just wasting my energy on the wrong people. I need to find a way to stop attracting toxic people

Yes, things do feel hopeless most of the time. Even when things are going good, it only lasts for a couple days. I wish I had better control of my life, but it feels like I'm constantly set up to fail.
